aria: Animated recap of the Nuggets' 114 to 102 win over Indiana in Mexico City: Jamal Murray's 29-foot step-back three with 8:33 left, quarter-by-quarter scoring, Nikola Jokić's 19 points, 13 rebounds and 8 assists, the top scorers, how the Nuggets won, and the next game at Houston.
notes: Box score from the Nuggets' 114–102 win over the Indiana Pacers in Mexico City on Nov 7, 2026 (Indiana was the home team), from Covers.com's full box score, with the line score and first-quarter play-by-play from CBS Sports' gametracker and game details from the AP (via theScore and CBS Sports), AFP (via Yahoo Sports), DenverSports.com, The Gazette and Yardbarker. All 114 points are accounted for in the box score. The league stats feed wasn't available for this recap, so records come from the site's standings through Nov 6 plus Saturday's results (Denver 5–3; Houston 7–3 after losing at Phoenix).

Biggest leads: Denver's 27 (64–37 late in the first half, per the AP) and Indiana's 5 (5–0 early in the first quarter, per CBS Sports' play-by-play). Points in the paint (54–44) are from DenverSports.com; rebounds, free throws, threes and turnovers are from the box score.

The play of the game is an original illustration of Jamal Murray's step-back three from 29 feet with 8:33 left, which DenverSports.com says made it 102–90 after Denver's lead had fallen to single digits. Indiana got within 102–95 a minute later, and Denver answered with six straight points. The figures are stylized and not traced from footage, and the spacing is not to scale.

The music is an original beat made for this page. No existing recordings or melodies are used. This is an unofficial fan recap, not affiliated with the Denver Nuggets or the NBA, which is why it carries a plain basketball mark and the team's colors but not the team's logo.

The shooter in the play of the game is drawn to Murray’s listed 6-foot-4 and 215 pounds (Basketball-Reference), with arms scaled to his reported 6-foot-6½ wingspan (Hoops Habit's 2016 draft scouting report). It is an original silhouette with a featureless face, not a portrait or a trace of footage.
